nodes.name: Telegram spike ping
nodes.notes: Replace <REPLACE-TOKEN> with your bot token or set IGNIS_TELEGRAM_URL env. Delete this node if Telegram is not wanted.

meta.description: IGNIS workflow #2 — high-frequency RED-spike watch. Polls /api/hooks/digest every 15 minutes and immediately emails + Telegram-pings when any monitored region crosses the RED early-alert threshold. Companion to ignis-n8n-workflow.json (daily 21:00 UTC digest). Import into n8n: Workflows → Import from file. Set env vars: IGNIS_HOOK_TOKEN (optional), IGNIS_ALERT_TO, IGNIS_ALERT_FROM, IGNIS_TELEGRAM_URL, IGNIS_TELEGRAM_CHAT.
